summary: Verified all 10 bug fixes / features for Tablezy (BUG-A1..A6, C1..C4). Backend flows tested end-to-end via curl; frontend flows verified via Playwright. Guest-order backfill, loyalty point crediting (10 pts per ₹100), reward redemption via cart, admin customers page, reward badge on orders, year range filter, image dropzone with gallery/camera/URL — all working correctly.

BUG-A4: /admin/history has [data-testid=range-year] button; frontend converts range→start_date/end_date on /api/orders (returned 9 orders for year).

Admin login (admin@tablezy.com/admin123) works; customer login for backfilled account (9111100088/pass123) works.
